As Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Valuation Rose, Holder Scge Management LP Upped Its Position; Goodman Financial Increases Stake in Helmerich & Payne Com (HP)
May 8, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Christopher Lyle increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 58.99% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scge Management Lp bought 128,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Christopher Lyle held 345,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $59.49M, up from 217,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scge Management Lp who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.95B market cap company. The stock increased 3.42% or $6.46 during the last trading session, reaching $195.35. About 29.86 million shares traded or 61.91% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Goodman Financial Corp increased its stake in Helmerich & Payne Inc Com (HP) by 6.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goodman Financial Corp bought 4,695 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.36% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 75,935 shares of the energy company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.91M, up from 71,240 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goodman Financial Corp who had been investing in Helmerich & Payne Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.48B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.76% or $1.23 during the last trading session, reaching $68.67. About 2.06M shares traded or 36.24% up from the average. Helmerich & Payne, Inc. (NYSE:HP) has risen 3.63% since May 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.92% the S&P500.
Goodman Financial Corp, which manages about $291.99 million and $221.21M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,946 shares to 53,785 shares, valued at $9.10M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cvs Health Corp Com (NYSE:CVS) by 58,539 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 90 shares, and cut its stake in Vanguard Short (VCSH).
